name: Avatar of Shulkers
description:
You reflect projectiles and take -25% damage from them. Punch the block below you while sneaking to close your shell until you stop sneaking. While your shell is closed:

  • You take -25% damage.

  • Jumping blinks you to a random nearby location.

  • Fired arrows become Shulker bullets. If the target already had levitation, it is cleansed and the resulting fall deals 4x damage.
